witness.explanation: The retained exact-minor checker establishes a rank condition, while the non-extension conclusion additionally requires an external theorem that the export does not prove or bind.
witness.evidence: The supplied minor det=327892164673536-146637833895936*sqrt(5) is nonzero, establishing rank(P o P)=10 for the relevant Gram matrix. The checker ends at that rank result. The subsequent implication from an extreme non-cut elliptope point to non-extension to the degree-four generalized elliptope is serialized as an external input, without a bound proof or citation in this artifact. Thus the artifact is not a self-contained proof of the claimed non-extension. No counterexample to the non-extension theorem is asserted.

adjudication.rationale_zh: 原指控把导出脚本中未重印外部定理误当成证明缺桥。原始网页捕获明确引用 Bandeira–Kunisky（arXiv:1812.11583v2），陈述非 cut 的 extreme elliptope point 不能延拓为 degree-4 pseudomoment，并给出 rank(X odot X)=10 的使用条件。随后协调器提供精确 minor，脚本才将其标为 external input。原始引用并未缺失；该外部命题也与所引用论文 Theorem 2.17 相符。现有 witness 只证明 checker 本身不重证外部定理，不能证明这个数学推断有错。
adjudication.history_reconciliation: 旧 source_reviewed/承重桥梁遗漏裁定遗漏了原 rollout 中的网页正文与定理链接；上一轮 pending 发现的问题现已通过既有原始工具输出消除。排除本条指控，不声称整个 H4 项目已被重新认证。
adjudication.verification_basis: Read original browser tool captures and external-input export. Independently checked primary paper https://arxiv.org/html/1812.11583v2, Theorem 2.17, equations (17)-(18) and its extreme-point consequence: an extreme rank-greater-than-one correlation matrix has no degree-4 extension. Did not rerun the full Gram reconstruction or certify other H4 claims.
adjudication.witness_scope: Current missing-bridge allegation refuted by retained original context; no counterexample to the non-extension conclusion.
